engine: Offline sizing analysis (pytket gate census + ideal statevector)

formula.note: The +5 is per circuit, so for small circuits the program count dominates the bill before a single shot is taken.

envelope.limit: target <= 100, hard stop 1000, absolute ceiling 2000 with noise
envelope.why: Fidelity collapses past this on ion traps.

envelope.limit: 4-20 for a demonstrator; 30+ before classical simulation stops being easy
